cases.rationale: Independent, operative joint technology/research governance: mandatory agreement and merit-review framework with qualified research/data/infrastructure options. The exact whole choice qualifies for a proposal under the existing rule without requiring realized technology deployment.
cases.strongest_counterevidence: Agricultural/energy research with many optional activities and security/reporting provisions, not an appropriated construction or deployment project. The case rests on the mandatory research-governance mechanism, not the bill title or a universal research rule.

cases.rationale: The exact instruction targets funding of an identified transformative energy-technology research agency. That whole research-funding mechanism is the case basis; the retained nested proviso and legal-application limit are material, not silently removed.
cases.strongest_counterevidence: An appropriations-line edit with unresolved application of the retained direction proviso, rather than a program repeal or an established fiscal result. Support/opposition cannot identify which research component a member preferred.

cases.rationale: The whole administrative-line/fee interaction is grounded, but whether this exact administration-budget instruction independently establishes Infrastructure technology-finance governance remains a reserved case boundary. Route the exact question with its literal mechanism and legal-application qualifications; no general administrative-funding rule.
cases.strongest_counterevidence: Title17 finances conditional innovative energy/physical-infrastructure projects, giving an independent technology-finance connection. The targeted line concerns administration and unchanged offsets/fees, not a direct new project award or a determined reduction of available program resources.

cases.rationale: The entire targeted account has direct energy research, technology deployment, transportation/infrastructure and efficiency mechanisms. The whole account, nested amounts and household-assistance component are retained; the case basis is independent of the prior Health disposition.
cases.strongest_counterevidence: A mixed research/deployment/household-assistance and administrative account, with prior balances and general provisions. A rejected appropriation edit is not a repeal of all programs or proof of fiscal, deployment or household outcomes.

cases.rationale: Direct governance of electricity-grid interconnection proposals, regulator process and reliability reporting supplies an independent exact-case infrastructure mechanism. Its literal conditions and baseline limits are retained; no general energy-law inclusion rule is adopted.
cases.strongest_counterevidence: A regulatory/proposal framework rather than a construction appropriation, with explicit approval and reporting conditions and unintegrated current-tariff baselines. It does not establish actual queue access, fuel winners or reliability/cost outcomes.
